notes.title: Streamers' update! (Connect to your Twitch, YouTube, Kick or Tiktok LIVE)
notes.content:
Even though Burgie's Cozy Kitchen started as a chill single-player cooking game, it’s always had a fun twist, a Twitch mode where your viewers can jump in and order virtual burgies while you stream.

Well, we’ve got some tasty news:
We're now the first game to bring this feature to even more live chat platforms!

You can now connect with:
- Twitch.tv chat
- YouTube Live chat
- Kick.com chat
- TikTok LIVE chat

That means more viewers, more interactions, and way more engage with your audience. Perfect to make your channel grow!

Plus, there’s now a Bit queue system: viewers who donate get priority when placing their orders. Just a couple of burgers and you’ve basically paid off the game! 😁

If you stream it, drop your stream links here. I’d love to see your burger joint empire in action!
